mission.title: vllm: [Bug]: [gpt oss 20b] [tool_call] Unexpected token 12606 while expecting start token 200006
mission.description: [Bug]: [gpt oss 20b] [tool_call] Unexpected token 12606 while expecting start token 200006. Users encounter: "openai_harmony.HarmonyError:".

steps.title: Identify vllm troubleshoot symptoms
steps.description:
Check for the issue in your vllm installation:
```bash
pip show vllm | grep Version
python -c "import vllm; print(vllm.__version__)"
```
Look for error: `openai_harmony.HarmonyError: Unexpected token 12606 while expecting start token 200006`

steps.title: Review vllm configuration
steps.description:
Review the relevant vllm configuration:
### Your current environment

uv venv --python 3.12 --seed
source .venv/bin/activate
uv pip install --pre vllm==0.10.1+gptoss \
    --extra-index-url https://wheels.vllm.ai/gpt-oss/ \
    --extra-index-url

steps.title: Apply the fix for [Bug]: [gpt oss 20b] [tool_call] Unexpected token 12606…
steps.description:
This PR brings openai-harmony tool support and reasoning for /chat/completions.


gpt-oss-20b

Experiencing the same issue with **vllm v0.10.2** `openai.InternalServerError: Error code: 500 - {'error': {'message': 'Unexpected token 12606 while expecting start token 200006', 'type': 'Internal Server Error', 'param': None, 'code': 500}}`

https://github.com/vllm-project/vllm/issues/22515#issuecomment-3298624205
When using vLLM to run inference with gpt-oss-120b, I encountered the error: “Unexpected token 200002 while expecting start token 200006.”

After investigation, the issue is not in vLLM’s generation process, but rather that gpt-oss produced invalid text. Specifically, the tokens generated by the model must be decoded using the Harmony codebase; if the model outputs invalid text, Harmony’s decoding logic will raise an error.

In my case the model that triggered this error is gpt
